messages:
emily_cs: draft outbound for customers impacted by this morning's onboarding slowness. short, clear, no jargon. please quick-review: summary, root cause, what we fixed, ETA, credit offer, RSVP + renewal escalation.

dan_eng: RCA: a feature flag misrouted ~25% of ingestion traffic into a degraded shard class at ~03:18 UTC which slowed some onboarding imports. we reverted the flag at 03:29 UTC and kicked off an accelerated backfill. throughput is ~82% now. incident INC-2026-63987.

emily_cs: proposed customer note below — edit for tone/accuracy:

emily_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
Were sorry for the disruption. Earlier today (around 03:150:35 UTC) a configuration change briefly slowed processing for some onboarding uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and started an accelerated backfill; systems are processing and we expect full catch-up within 4 6 hours from now.

Why this happened: an ingestion routing flag was applied incorrectly which routed a portion of uploads into a lower-throughput queue (INC-2026-63987).
What we did: reverted the flag, increased backfill workers by 3x, patched the routing logic, and added extra monitoring until catch-up completes.
Impact: no data loss. Search and embeddings completeness will be restored once the backfill finishes.
Next steps: were holding two office hours today (14:30 & 18:30 UTC)  RSVP here: <RSVP_LINK>. Were offering a one-time onboarding credit up to $200 for impacted onboarding windows (credits applied at company discretion; see T&C: <T_AND_C_LINK>). If youre in a renewal window or need prioritized help, reply and well schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Thanks for your patience,
 Emily, Customer Success```

rafa_se: small edits: change "increased backfill workers by 3x" -> "temporarily increased backfill workers by 3x and patched routing code". add internal incident doc link for AEs: <INTERNAL_INC_LINK>.

tom_ae: Ill flag customers with renewals in the next 90 days and start SEP handoffs. can we add a one-question checkbox in the outbound asking if this affects renewal timing? helps prioritize outreach.

legal_bot: legal approved the credit wording "one-time onboarding credit up to $200". include clause "credits applied at company discretion" and link to T&Cs.

status_bot: INC-2026-63987 status: RESOLVED (flag reverted + backfill in progress). public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-63987 :white_check_mark:

emily_cs: updated draft with edits and links. checklist before send: 1) insert RSVP + calendar invites 2) append renewal-flagged list (tom) 3) include T&C link (legal) 4) AE/SEP pings + internal incident doc. aiming to send at 09:30 UTC.

rafa_se: Ill run the 14:30 office hour and capture blockers; attaching a 1-page troubleshooting checklist will speed triage.

emily_cs: perfect. ill post the final outbound here 15 minutes before send for a last sign-off. also adding a tiny feedback checkbox to capture whether customers want a renewal review session. :thumbsup:
